subject: general
question: What is the name of the fishery project in Assam for which the Centre and ADB have signed a $1 million technical assistance grant to support?

options.text: Sustainable Wetland and Integrated Fisheries Transformation Project

solution:
Correct Answer: Sustainable Wetland and Integrated Fisheries Transformation (SWIFT) Project

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

The Government of India and the Asian Development Bank signed over $800 million in development financing, including a $1 million technical assistance grant for a fisheries and wetlands project in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Centre and ADB formalised a $1 million technical assistance grant dedicated to Assam’s fisheries and wetland ecosystem improvement.
 
• The support is specifically for the Sustainable Wetland and Integrated Fisheries Transformation (SWIFT) Project.
 
• The project focuses on enhancing wetland ecological health and promoting sustainable, modernised fisheries in the state.
 
• SWIFT aims to improve livelihoods dependent on fisheries while strengthening long-term ecological resilience in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra Loan:** $500 million for agricultural solarization under the Power Distribution Enhancement Programme.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh Loan:** ¥27.14 billion (~$190.6 million) for the Indore Metro underground corridor.
 
• **Gujarat Loan:** $109.97 million for the Skills Development Programme led by Kaushalya: The Skill University.
 
• **ADB India Mission:** Agreements were signed by Mio Oka (ADB) and Saurabh Singh (DEA), Government of India.
